summary: Completed a refactor of the agent-server transport layer so a single PiAgentService, ProjectServiceRegistry, and ExtensionHostService are owned by the WebSocket server for its lifetime, with a shared ProjectWatchCoordinator ref-counting extension-host watches across services. Closing a tab no longer aborts or disposes anything; sessions survive disconnects and reattach via the existing snapshot path.
decisions: Server owns one PiAgentService, ProjectServiceRegistry, and ExtensionHostService for its lifetime; factory options are purely test seams invoked once per server.
WebsocketConnection reduced to subscribing/unsubscribing to a shared event hub (~30 lines); it no longer aborts or disposes anything on close.

ProjectWatchCoordinator moved from per-connection to a shared class: one extension-host watch per path ref-counted across services, events broadcast to all sockets. Documented constraint that the last tab to select a project wins live updates, relying on the client's re-watch-on-selection behavior.
Server close() detaches clients, aborts streaming sessions, then disposes resources with each dispose isolated so one throw cannot leak the others.
Pre-existing check:loc failures on 6 oversized files (none touched by this change) were treated as out of scope for this refactor.
errors: pnpm check:loc failed: 6 pre-existing files exceed the 300-line limit (e.g., scripts/dev-server.ts 357, resource-catalog.ts 333). Confirmed none of them were files touched in this change; failure treated as pre-existing.
